findings.title: Current-schema dynamics state is rewritten on AU recall
findings.detail: migrateLegacyDynamics uses panel enable values rather than checking whether modern panel parameters were present in the incoming state. A saved current state with dynamics on and both panels off is treated as legacy. In the focused AU test Below On changes 0→1, Below Range 6→−12 dB and Below Ratio 50→100. VST3 host round-trips passed in this run, so the actual host failure is qualified as AU; the format-independent processor harness reproduces the same migration error.

findings.title: Clip reset hit target and latch are broken
findings.detail: The drawn LED begins below y=34, but mouseDown only resets when y<34. Clicking the LED leaves it red. Clicking the header clears only the local flag; the processor latch remains true and the next timer sets red again. Synthetic component interaction and source inspection agree.

findings.title: Light theme makes numeric readouts and controls unreadable
findings.detail: Several readout plates and surfaces stay dark while text changes to the light theme's dark foreground. Some label colours are captured at construction and remain stale across a theme change. Screenshots simulate the same Theme::applyTheme/repaint path; they establish rendered contrast, not native menu operation.

findings.title: Five processing parameters have no GUI controls
findings.detail: autoGain, spectralAmount, spectralThresh, spectralFreq, spectralOct are in the host registry and processor but have no UI bindings. Separately, 96 legacy slope/range/action parameters are retained without dedicated controls; they are listed rather than silently excused.

findings.title: Output peak release changes with host block size
findings.detail: At 48 kHz, a 20 dB decay takes 25.33 ms at 32-sample blocks versus 810.67 ms at 1,024 samples. The backend multiplies by 0.94 once per block. GUI smoothing may impose a slower display floor, but it does not make the backend ballistics time-invariant. RMS matches the mathematical current-block RMS, with no fixed integration window.

findings.title: Value and step policies are not consistently met
findings.detail: Examples include Q 40.00, attack 0.1 ms, and a −17.5 dB threshold. These conflict with default wiki/QA policies. Fractional ratio formatting X.X:1 is an existing user request and must not be changed to satisfy a generic policy without considering that preference.

findings.title: The beta label is hidden in the plugin UI
findings.detail: The version macro and README retain 0.3.0-beta, but the editor puts the version label at zero size. Repository beta marking is present; visible in-plugin beta marking is absent.

findings.title: Input section missing under the canonical QA rule
findings.detail: The GUI has a complete output column but no dedicated input level/trim section. This fails the skill's input/output-section requirement; it is not a claim that the audio input bus is broken.

findings.title: Full background painters do not declare opacity
findings.detail: The editor fills its full background but omits setOpaque(true). The transformed stage needs a separate bounds/opacity check; no measured CPU penalty is claimed. Rounded cards and translucent overlays must remain non-opaque.
